sea slugs text index | photo index Phylum Mollusca

Class Gastropoda > sea slugs > Family Onchidiidae Ornate onch slug
awaiting identification*
Family Onchidiidaeupdated Jun 2020

Where seen? This small oval slug with an ornate texture is sometimes seen in mangroves in the North.

Features: 3-5cm. Body hard, oval, rounded. Skin with regular pattern of bumps with blunt spikes on them, resulting in a very ornate texture! Colour plain, beige or greyish. Eyes on long thin stalks. Underside and narrow foot are pale to lemon yellow.


Kranji Nature Trail, Jan 09


Eyes on stalks.


Underside


Pulau Semakau, Feb 09

***Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
